description: Entrances to the underground metro and premetro stations on the territory of the City of Brussels or nearby is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Entrances to the underground metro and premetro stations on the territory of the City of Brussels or nearby Please note that the location of the entrances may sometimes lack precision. These discrepancies are gradually corrected at the source by STIB/MIVB and are automatically reflected in this dataset. Source:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility, Public space. Its keywords are station, stop, metro, tram, stib, underground. The portal shows 109 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
